notes.evidence: Source inspection at the pinned revisions; no full inference observation claimed.
notes.producer: ami-data-companion ObjectDetector post_process_single (2023 ResNet50 and MobileNetV3)
notes.scope: One image after author thresholding; post_process_batch adds an outer image list. Excludes raw torchvision tensors, database records and downstream API detections/classifications.
notes.coordinates: [x1, y1, x2, y2], original-image pixels, origin top-left. NumPy astype(int) truncates the retained coordinates toward zero.
notes.confidence: The author filters scores strictly greater than 0.80 (2023 ResNet50) or 0.50 (MobileNetV3), then discards scores and labels. Neither confidence nor class is present in this output.
